title: Keep detailed report artifacts off the optimization critical path
description:
As an optimization operator, I want authoritative milestone decisions published before detailed artifact enrichment, so that report generation does not delay diagnosis or execution.

Feature: Core-first milestone publication

Scenario: An intermediate milestone advances
  Given decision evidence, the stakeholder workbook, and aggregate presentation are valid
  When the milestone is published
  Then the immutable core revision becomes authoritative
  And the procedure may continue before score-level and scorecard-level artifacts are generated

Scenario: Final detail enrichment fails
  Given optimizer evidence is already durable
  When final detail enrichment cannot complete
  Then optimizer evidence remains preserved
  And the run is visibly incomplete and retryable
  And the Report is not labeled complete

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Beginning outside-in specifications for core-first milestone publication and deferred detail enrichment. Scope: report service and focused tests only; no schema, resource, dashboard, or procedure changes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Core-first publication implementation is green in focused validation. Intermediate milestones now commit compact decision evidence, workbook, aggregate presentation, and manifest without score or scorecard artifact generation. Final detail enrichment is separately retryable, reuses checksum-verified unchanged detail artifacts, regenerates the aggregate detail presentation for its current source revision, and cannot mark the Report complete until reconciled. Validation: 103 focused report/action tests and 303 broader optimization report/decision/portfolio tests passed; dashboard realtime/report tests and typecheck passed. No deployment, push, new production run, or automatic promotion occurred.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Performance-fix validation update: intermediate milestones now commit only decision evidence, workbook, aggregate presentation, and the core manifest before stage advancement. Score and scorecard enrichment is deferred to final detail publication with pending/complete source-revision labels, checksum reuse, and retry recovery that preserves terminal optimizer evidence. Focused report tests include large-portfolio core-first ordering, enrichment failure, cross-process resume, and final reconciliation; 103 focused backend tests passed. The existing legacy pilot still retries its old large artifact publication path and is being retained as baseline evidence.
